basic_info.description: Spacious 5000 sq. ft. duplex with 30 ft. frontage. The living rooms have views of tennis courts and downtown. The upper master unit has 3 bedrooms and 2 baths. The middle unit has 4 bedrooms and 2 baths. There is bi-level family room, den, study and recreation spaces for entertainment. There are laundry areas in the 4-car garage. The landscaped backyard has mature trees for quiet enjoyment.  The property is near tennis courts, Lincoln park, schools and all conveniences.
